directivePlacement.text: The COBOL-WORDS directive may be specified only before the first IDENTIFICATION DIVISION within a compilation group

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.10.2 general format + §2023:7.3.10.3 SR1-SR5: EQUATE / UNDEFINE / SUBSTITUTE / RESERVE entries over word literals — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1623.

description: The >>COBOL-WORDS { EQUATE l1 WITH l2 | UNDEFINE l3 | SUBSTITUTE l4 BY l5 | RESERVE l6 } compiler directive (ISO §2023:7.3.10; Annex D.12; Annex E.3.3 item 12) — a COBOL-2023 addition (Annex E.2 item 5 lists COBOL-WORDS among the compiler-directive words new to 2023). It modifies which words are reserved / context-sensitive / intrinsic-function words and prohibits specified user-defined words, per compilation group, during the text-manipulation stage. Recognized and parsed by CobolWordsDirectiveProcessor into a CobolWordsMap consumed by the post-lex token rewriter + the composed ReservedWordSet + intrinsic-name resolution; the introduction gate rejects the directive word below 2023.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.10; Annex D.12; Annex E.3.3 item 12; Annex E.2 item 5 (compiler-directive words added in 2023)
source:
>>COBOL-WORDS RESERVE "FOO"
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CWORDS.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
